description: A class that monitors incoming cluster health probe requests within the Orleans runtime, providing timing and state management for health checks.

classes.name: ProbeRequestMonitor
classes.description: Monitors incoming cluster health probe requests and tracks the elapsed time since the last received request.

methods.name: OnReceivedProbeRequest
methods.description: Handles the event when a health probe request is received; restarts the stopwatch to measure elapsed time.

methods.name: ElapsedSinceLastProbeRequest
methods.description: Property that returns the TimeSpan representing elapsed time since the last probe request if the stopwatch is running; otherwise, null.
